_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Manuals
summary: Establishes requirements for acquiring sample Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) manuals for evaluation and use, as is or with supplementation, to support COTS equipment used by DOD.
use_relationship:
Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) manuals may be used as is or with supplementation to support COTS equipment used by DOD.  This Data Item Description (DID) is used to acquire sample COTS manuals for evaluation and use.

This DID contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The COTS manual shall be presented in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The COTS manual shall contain all of the technical information required for the operation and maintenance of the commercial equipment in compliance with the contract and applicable Technical Manual Contract Requirement (TMCR).

preparation_instructions.title: Media requirement
preparation_instructions.content: The manual shall be presented in an indexed Portable Document Format (iPDF) file for electronic COTS manuals.  When applicable, paper manuals shall be clearly legible and on 8-1/2 x 11 inch plain bond paper.
